name: Ellen - London accent
description: My voice is somewhat a contradiction, I can be well spoken, slight huskiness but sometimes the West London cockney twang comes out.

name: Ruby B - Authentic Cockney London Female
description: A lively, characterful London female voice with natural Cockney roots, warm conversational delivery, quick wit and plenty of personality. Versatile for modern dialogue, gaming, animation and period characters.

name: Nishma - Warm, sparkly, very London
description: Nishma's chatty, friendly voice for voice overs on content and instructional videos.

name: British South London Female | Clear, Warm, Trustworthy | Universal Appeal for All Ages
description: British South London accent with a neutral, modern delivery. Not posh and not slang-heavy. Clear diction with warm authority. Calm, confident and conversational. Professional but human, never over-produced. Strong storytelling tone with emotional intelligence. Easy to listen to over long sessions. Suitable for training, e-learning, explainers, compliance, documentaries, branded content, podcasts and social video. Trustworthy, relatable and credible British voice.

name: Maria - Warm, Sophisticated Londoner
description: A sophisticated, warm, lower-pitched female English voice speaking in a London accent with a Slavic twang. Perfect for audiobooks and other narrations.

name: Catherine - British English
description: A middle-aged British female voice with a distinctive Southern English accent, blending Kentish and London influences.

name: Esjai
description: South London, mature English woman.

name: Isabel - Warm & Clear
description: 30-year-old female Londoner whose voice is warm, clever, friendly, academic, and clear.

name: Sophia
description: A warm, feminine British voice with a soft multicultural London foundation, subtle Irish influence and a lightly international, almost transatlantic quality. Medium-to-medium-high pitch with a gentle breathiness and faint husky undertone. Relaxed articulation, fluid conversational rhythm, expressive upward inflections and natural pauses. Intimate, intelligent, playful and emotionally warm, with a polished but not overly formal delivery.

name: Eleanor - Warm British & Midlands Narrator
description: A highly pleasant, clear, and mature British female voice (43). Features a unique, engaging blend of soft Derbyshire/Midlands roots and crisp London tones. Articulate, conversational, and comforting. Ideal for premium audiobooks, e-learning courses, documentary narration, and corporate media.

name: Olivia - Educated British Female
description: Warm, articulate, and engaging British female voice with an educated London accent and a refined contemporary feel. Ideal for luxury brands, storytelling, podcasts, audiobooks, documentaries, social media content, UGC campaigns, product launches, and premium digital content. Combining elegance, clarity, and natural storytelling, this voice helps brands, creators, and businesses connect with their audience in a way that feels authentic, memorable, and deeply human.

name: Amanda - Warm, Intelligent and Editorial
description: Warm, confident Black British female voice. Conversational and intelligent with a natural London tone. Ideal for lifestyle, finance, and editorial content.

name: Samantha - Professional British Female
description: A soothing female voice with a well-spoken London accent with a dash of Essex.

name: Cass - Podcast Energy & Main Character
description: A young British female voice with a warm, lightly posh London accent. Engaging, curious, and slightly quirky, with the tone of a podcast host who’s very online. The kind of voice that probably has around 30,000 Instagram followers and digs a matcha latte. Conversational and expressive, with subtle humour, natural pacing, and a talent for storytelling. Ideal for podcasts, social media narration, cultural commentary, and long-form spoken content.

name: Evelyn - Resourceful and Ironic
description: A thoughtful, analytical and witty character voice.  Restrained, composed, intelligent, grounded and quietly powerful. A touch of London irony and grit. Inspired by Evie Frye from Assassin's Creed Syndicate. Perfect for a determined and insightful heroin in video games. Ideal for audio books or for dialogue requiring a focused and pragmatic female role with a dry sense of humour. Recorded by Global Artist in a professional studio.

name: Lizzie - Cockney Character
description: A cheerful, energetic London Estuary/Cockney British accent. Inspired by Tracer from Overwatch, Eastenders and The Only Way Is Essex. Recorded by Global Artist in a professional studio.

name: Gabriella - Warm, Clear and Expressive
description: Soft British Female Voice — Native London Accent, Calm, Expressive, Gentle, Articulate and Elegant.

name: Blondie - Radio Host
description: Female voice with a London accent, professional radio announcer and DJ tone — confident, energetic, and engaging, ideal for hosting or presenting.

name: Michelle - Direct and Natural
description: Authentic Northern Ireland straight talker.  North West, Donegal, Derry (Londonderry) & Tyrone.

name: Emma Taylor - Gentle Thoughtful Narrator
description: A young British English story teller with a London accent and a soft gentle voice. Perfect for narrations.

name: Jane - Smooth, Friendly and Professional
description: A measured and trustworthy female British voice of authority with a soft London accent and a deeper pitch. Works well for Informative & educational content.

name: Samantha
description: Natural, calm & freindly, British English, regional Essex accent.

name: Laura - Calm Warm British female
description: Warm, conversational British English female voice with a natural, approachable tone. Calm and relaxed delivery with a slight South East England/Estuary English influence. Medium pitch with a warm, clear timbre. Friendly, authentic, and confident without sounding overly formal. Speaks at a steady, natural pace with clear articulation and subtle expressiveness. Ideal for podcasts, audiobooks, educational content, and conversational narration.
